messages:
maya: Heads up — NimbusPay is hitting repeated inference timeouts on /v1/generate since ~03:12 UTC. Error rate jumped to ~7%. They're flagging this as a potential SLA breach if we don't mitigate in the next hour. Ticket NP-482 created.
ryan: Can you paste a short log sample and the model they're using?
maya: Sample log snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T03:14:21Z ERROR request_id=abc123 timeout waiting for token stream (model: redwood-7b-quant)
2026-03-17T03:15:03Z WARN backend queue depth=120 latency_ms=9200
```
They're on redwood-7b-quant via hosted route: customer/nimbuspay/prod.
sophia: Noted. Looks like burst+quantization edge-case + cold KV cache. I'll check pool utilization and pending autoscale events.
derek: Incident-bot shows a flurry of 504s from our edge LB at 03:12. I'm going to push a quick gateway timeout bump from 30s -> 60s and enable our fallback routing to redwood-7b-std for that customer route. PR is ready: https://git.internal/r/gw/PR/452 (will queue after approvals).
ryan: I'll own the fallback routing (route policy change + canary). Plan: add route override to force model variant fallback when queue > 80 or mean latency > 1500ms. Rolling canary to 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 15m. ETA for first canary: 20–25m.
lisa: I'll let NimbusPay PM know we have a mitigation plan: gateway timeout + model fallback + scale check. They asked for ETA under 1 hour.
sophia: Scaling update: Dedicated pool is near full for that region (us-west-2). I can request a temporary burst (2x) from capacity team but that takes ~40m to provision. Alternative: enable cross-region fallback to us-east-1 for this customer; network RTT might add ~20ms. Which do we prefer?
maya: Cross-region fallback seems faster. NimbusPay agreed to tolerate slight latency increase if it avoids errors. @ryan please include cross-region fallback in canary.
ryan: Will do. Also adding KV cache warming for top 50 prompts (hot-path) — running warming job now, should reduce first-token latency for subsequent requests in ~10m.
derek: Gateway PR merged and deployed to prod (canary 10% edge). Monitoring.
incident-bot: [ALERT] Route customer/nimbuspay/prod error_rate=6.8% latency_p95=9.4s -> mitigation in progress.
lisa: Customer notified: "Engineering is applying mitigations (timeout bump + fallback + cache warming). ETA estimate 45–60 minutes." They asked for a point of contact -> I'm the CS POC.
sophia: Scaling request filed to capacity with high priority. Tracker: CAP-789. If cross-region fallback not sufficient we'll have the burst in 40m.
ryan: Summary of actions: 1) Gateway timeout -> 60s (done) 2) Model fallback canary (started, 10% -> 25% soon) 3) KV cache warming job (in progress) 4) Cross-region fallback enabled in canary 5) Capacity burst request (CAP-789)
maya: Thanks team. Can we do a check-in at +30m to confirm error rate trend? I'll post an update to the customer thread then.
derek: Confirming logs show a drop in 504s on the canary edges. P95 latency still high but error rate trending down.
lisa: NimbusPay replied: "Thanks, please keep us updated. We'll track SLA window." :thumbsup:
ryan: I'll post final status in 30m. If anything spikes, page oncall.
maya: Closing loop: action owners listed (ryan fallback + warming, sophia capacity, derek gateway, lisa customer comms). Next check-in 30m.
